workarounds.symptom: [Bug] DashScope TTS 无法调用 qwen-audio-3.0-tts-plus 模型，返回 InvalidParameter: url error
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: support Qwen-Audio-TTS in DashScope provider. Target files: astrbot/core/config/default.py, astrbot/core/provider/sources/dashscope_tts.py, dashboard/src/i18n/locales/en-US/features/config-metadata.json. - Route Qwen-Audio-TTS models through the existing `SpeechSynthesizer` implementation instead of `MultiModalConversation`. - Add an optional, instance-local WebSocket endpoint setting while preserving the SDK default when it is blank. - Add Chinese, Japanese, English, and Russian translations, regression coverage, ... (Ref: https://github.com/AstrBotDevs/AstrBot/pull/10495)
